# routeros_routing_settings (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_routing_settings" "settings" {
  check_gateway_ping_count    = 1
  check_gateway_ping_interval = "10s"
  check_gateway_ping_timeout  = "10s"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `check_gateway_ping_count` (Number) How many consecutive gateway checks have to fail before the gateway is considered unreachable.
- `check_gateway_ping_interval` (String) The interval between the gateway reachability checks.
- `check_gateway_ping_timeout` (String) How long to wait for a reply before a single gateway check is considered failed.
- `connected_in_chain` (String) Name of the routing filter chain that is applied to the connected routes before they are installed in the routing table.
- `dynamic_in_chain` (String) Name of the routing filter chain that is applied to the dynamically added routes, for example the ones coming from DHCP or PPP, before they are installed in the routing table.
- `policy_rules` (List of String) The ordered list of the built-in routing policy stages. It defines in which order the routing decision consults the mangle marks, the VRF lookup and unreachable rules, the local and the user defined `/routing/rule` entries and the main table. The order is significant.
- `single_process` (Boolean) Run all the routing protocol processes in a single process instead of spreading them over the available cores. Useful for troubleshooting.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/routing/settings get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_routing_settings.settings "*1"
```
